matter_friction_ramp.name: Matter / Let Go
matter_friction_ramp.description: A tilted plank and a cube: change the angle/contact, then let native gravity and friction decide.
interactions: Adjust with the pink controls before release.
Release for a physical take; repeat after it settles.
Right-click or grip carries a cube; reset restores authored positions.
matter_friction_ramp.qfep_connection: The threshold is a physical relation between contact, force and history rather than an instantaneous Boolean promise.

matter_friction_coast.name: Matter / Keep Going
matter_friction_coast.description: Two equal cubes receive the same impulse. Different contact surfaces yield different actual stopping distances.
interactions: Press SAME PUSH to give both cubes one identical impulse.
Release for a physical take; repeat after it settles.

matter_leaning_together.name: Matter / Leaning Together
matter_leaning_together.description: A precarious gravity balance: the planks stand on narrow edges, chocks barely support their feet and the cube balances above. A light physical tap can dismantle the arrangement. The ball is a loose probe weight in the tray.
interactions: Left-click or use a VR pointer trigger for one finite contact nudge. An ungripped VR hand can physically touch and disturb the parts.
Right-click or grip to hold and move any of the six loose parts. Desktop: wheel for reach, Q/E roll, Z/X tilt, Shift+Q/E yaw.
Reset restores the authored precarious pose and immediately returns all six parts to gravity. The editor preview is static; physics runs in Godot.
matter_leaning_together.qfep_connection: Support belongs to an arrangement of bodies and hands. Several postures can persist; collapse is recorded as movement rather than declared failure.

parameters.brittle: True selects the narrow-edge precarious arrangement. False selects the earlier braced posture.
parameters.balance_offset: Small authored cube offset across the narrow bearing (metres); edited member poses take precedence.
